info.ad_astra.cable: Transmit electrical energy. Use the wrench right click to change the dispense mode.
info.ad_astra.cable_duct: Similar to a cable, but completely airtight with no leaks.
info.ad_astra.coal_generator: The simplest generator. Generating energy from combustible materials.
info.ad_astra.compressor: The material can be compressed into plates.
info.ad_astra.cryo_freezer: Can convert ice materials into ice fuel.
info.ad_astra.energizer: Store large amounts of electrical energy. Right click to charge the item. It retains its electrical energy when destroyed.
info.ad_astra.etrionic_blast_furnace: Smelts minerals into ingots like a blast furnace, but uses electricity and has 4 input slots. There are 2 modes: smelting and co-casting.
info.ad_astra.etrionic_capacitor: Store electrical energy. Right click to convert. SHIFT and right click to change allocation mode.
info.ad_astra.flag: A flag with your face on it. Right click to add image from URL.
info.ad_astra.fluid_duct: Similar to a fluid pipe, but completely airtight with no leaks.
info.ad_astra.fluid_pipe: transfer fluid. Use the wrench right click to change the dispense mode.
info.ad_astra.gas_tank: Storage fluid. Right click to assign to inventory.
info.ad_astra.globe: Right click to turn. Charge it with redstone to keep it spinning.
info.ad_astra.gravity_normalizer: Gravity can be controlled in local areas. Need to be used in a completely enclosed structure.
info.ad_astra.jet_suit: Similar to a netherite space suit, it is equipped with jets that propel the wearer forward with tremendous thrust.
info.ad_astra.launch_pad: Used to launch rockets. Charge it with redstone to automatically fire placed rockets.
info.ad_astra.netherite_space_suit: Similar to a regular space suit, with the added benefit of protecting the wearer from extreme heat.
info.ad_astra.oxygen_distributor: Can distribute oxygen and regulate temperature. Used to create a suitable living environment. Need to be used in a completely enclosed structure.
info.ad_astra.oxygen_loader: Convert water into oxygen. Used to fill space suits or fluid storage tanks.
info.ad_astra.oxygen_sensor: Emit a redstone signal when oxygen is detected. Use the wrench SHIFT and right click to invert the signal. Use the wrench right click to change the detection object.
info.ad_astra.radio: Can play real internet streaming radio stations.
info.ad_astra.rocket: Rockets for interstellar travel. Need to be placed on the launch pad. SHIFT and right click to manage its fuel and inventory.
info.ad_astra.rover: ATV. Shift and right click to manage its fuel and inventory. Right-click the screen to manage its radios. This radio can play real radio stations.
info.ad_astra.sliding_door: Huge 3x3 sized door. SHIFT and right click with the wrench to lock. When locked, it can only be opened using a redstone signal.
info.ad_astra.solar_panel: Gets energy from the sun during daylight hours. Note that the energy produced is relative to the planet.
info.ad_astra.space_suit: Provides oxygen to the wearer and protects them from extremely cold environments.
info.ad_astra.ti_69: Can display oxygen, temperature and gravity information
info.ad_astra.water_pump: Can pump water. Make sure there is a water source underneath it for it to work.
info.ad_astra.wrench: Used to adjust blocks such as pipes and cables.
info.ad_astra.zip_gun: Push you forward. Use the second one in your off hand to push further. Ideal for maneuvering in zero gravity.
